entities.name: Teysa Karlov
entities.description: The Matriarch of the Karlov family and Orzhov guildmaster, the wealthiest individual on Ravnica, who was assassinated and returned as a spirit.

entities.name: Orzhov Syndicate
entities.description: The Ravnican guild Teysa serves and leads.

entities.name: House Karlov
entities.description: One of the most respected Orzhov families, led by Teysa as Matriarch.

entities.name: Zomaj Hauc
entities.description: A figure with schemes to control Ravnica, responsible for the Schism, whom Teysa helped stop.

entities.name: Feather
entities.description: An angel who called on Teysa as her advokist during the Dissension.

entities.name: Obzedat
entities.description: The ghostly guildmasters of the Orzhov whom Teysa conspired to remove.

entities.name: Tajic
entities.description: A Boros knight who conspired with Teysa to remove the Obzedat.

entities.name: Grandfather Karlov
entities.description: Teysa's ghostly grandfather, killed by Kaya along with the Obzedat.

entities.name: Tomik Vrona
entities.description: Teysa's apprentice who kept her informed and later managed the guild's daily affairs.

entities.name: Kaya
entities.description: A planeswalker who freed Teysa, killed the Obzedat and became Orzhov guildmaster.

entities.name: Nicol Bolas
entities.description: A dragon and mutual friend of Teysa and Kaya who sent Kaya to free her.

entities.name: Lazav
entities.description: The Dimir guildleader who caused mayhem at the Forum of Azor and later allied with Teysa.

entities.name: Jace Beleren
entities.description: A planeswalker who became Ravnica's first Living Guildpact.

entities.name: Oba
entities.description: The central dryad of Trostani who engineered Teysa's murder.

entities.name: Alquist Proft
entities.description: A detective who deduced how Teysa was killed.

entities.name: Zegana
entities.description: A figure assassinated at Teysa's party.

entities.name: Implicit Maze
entities.description: The maze Teysa ran as the Orzhov's elected maze-runner.

entities.name: Guildpact
entities.description: The agreement among Ravnica's guilds, restored by the Supreme Verdict.

entities.name: New Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: The invasion during which Teysa learned Phyrexian and relayed intelligence.

entities.name: Ravnica
entities.description: The plane where Teysa lives.

entities.name: Karlov Manor
entities.description: Teysa's home where she hosted a party and was found dead.

events.summary: As baroness of the Utvara Reclamation Zone, Teysa helps stop Zomaj Hauc's schemes with an assembled force and a controlled dragon.
events.quote: she was influential in stopping Hauc

events.summary: After the Dissension Teysa helps draft a new non-magical Guildpact and becomes the first Grand Envoy of the Orzhov.
events.quote: has been made the first and only Grand Envoy of the Orzhov Syndicate

events.summary: Teysa completes the Implicit Maze but Lazav causes mayhem until Jace links the maze-runners' minds, triggering the Supreme Verdict and making him the Living Guildpact.
events.quote: this triggered the Supreme Verdict , which restored the Guildpact 's magic and empowered Jace as Ravnica's first Living Guildpact .

events.summary: Teysa's coup with Tajic against the Obzedat is foiled by her ghostly grandfather, and the Ghost Council strips her of her offices.
events.quote: she was foiled by her ghostly grandfather and stripped of her office of advokist and grand envoy by the Ghost Council.

events.summary: Kaya, sent by Bolas, infiltrates the catacombs and kills Grandfather Karlov and the Obzedat, becoming the new Orzhov leader; Teysa is reinstated as leading oligarch.
events.quote: Kaya infiltrated the catacombs and killed Grandfather Karlov and all other members of the Obzedat.

events.summary: Kaya frees bound ghosts from debt against Teysa's warning; the hierarchs pressure Teysa to arrest her but Tomik helps Kaya, and Teysa is arrested.
After the War of the Spark, Teysa takes the reins as Matriarch and allies with Lazav to play her rivals against each other.
events.quote: Teysa was content to be the power behind the curtain.

events.summary: During the New Phyrexian Invasion Teysa learns Phyrexian, supplies the resistance with intelligence, and claims guildmaster while Kaya is off-plane.
events.quote: claimed the title of guildmaster of the Orzhov.

events.summary: Teysa hosts a party at Karlov Manor; Zegana is assassinated and Teysa avoids questioning by the Azorius.
events.quote: After Zegana was assassinated at the party, Teysa avoided questioning by the Azorius.

events.summary: Kaya finds Teysa dead, stabbed with her own cane, with a note in Phyrexian beside her.
events.quote: Kaya discovered Teysa's body in her Manor, stabbed through the chest with her cane.

events.summary: Proft deduces a mind-controlled hitman killed Teysa through a plant cultivated by Oba, because of her perceived collaboration with the Phyrexians.
events.quote: The guild leader was targeted because of her perceived collaboration with the Phyrexians.

events.summary: Teysa returns as a spirit, appears at her funeral, thanks Kaya, retakes control of the Syndicate and recommends Kaya leave the plane.
events.quote: She reappeared at her funeral, thanking Kaya for following the case to its conclusion and retaking control of the Syndicate.

relations.quote: current guildmaster of the Orzhov Syndicate
Thanks to the efforts of her apprentice, Tomik Vrona
Kaya infiltrated the catacombs and killed Grandfather Karlov and all other members of the Obzedat.
she was foiled by her ghostly grandfather

relations.note: Conspired with him against the Obzedat.
relations.quote: she conspired with the Boros knight Tajic to remove the Obzedat from power.

relations.note: Kaya freed her and Teysa shared power with her.
relations.quote: Teysa was reinstated as the most powerful oligarch of the guild

relations.note: She joined Lazav to gain ultimate power.
relations.quote: Joining up with the Dimir guildmaster Lazav to gain the ultimate power
